hints.title: Tree Path Extraction
hints.text: Trace the unique simple path connecting the source node and destination node in the tree.

hints.title: Path Weight Accumulation
hints.text: Compute the sum of vertex weights along the extracted path to find the midpoint threshold.

hints.title: Prefix Threshold Scanning
hints.text: Walk from source to destination and return the first vertex whose cumulative weight reaches or exceeds half the total.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Breadth-first path retrieval and linear threshold evaluation per query.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full tree scans without pruning path vertices waste quadratic steps per query.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct parent pointers reconstruct path sequence without redundant graph copies.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify that the weighted median is the first prefix sum reaching half the total path weight.
